    It’s Time to Take Full Stock of Bond 26

    📅 24 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 6 min read (1103 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Esquire

    ⏱️ ~6 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • Industry observers note that the search for the latest James Bond was one of Hollywood’s most closely scrutinized casting processes.
    • Josh O’Connor was an early favorite until he stepped back in October, saying he planned a career break in 2027; the Daily Mail later reported that he had turned the role down.
    • Sources indicate that but after all that Bond-esque bluffing and counterbluffing from Amazon MGM Studios, Robert Pattinson was unveiled as the new 007 in mid-November.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Industry observers note that the search for the latest James Bond was one of Hollywood’s most closely scrutinized casting processes. Producer Amy Pascal said the team was being “really, really methodical” in its search for Craig’s successor, and the shortlist of hopefuls was as long as Bond’s list of ex-flings, with about the same survival rate.

    Josh O’Connor was an early favorite until he stepped back in October, saying he planned a career break in 2027; the Daily Mail later reported that he had turned the role down. Elsewhere, the betting and the gossip circled Slow Horses heartthrob Jack Lowden, Jacob Elordi, James Norton, Jack O’Connell, and Masters of the Air’s Callum Turner.

    Sources indicate that but after all that Bond-esque bluffing and counterbluffing from Amazon MGM Studios, Robert Pattinson was unveiled as the new 007 in mid-November. Everybody (mostly) breathed a sigh of relief—and turned their attention to the rest of the upcoming reboot. So, what do we know so far?

    Sources indicate that the second crucial element of Le Nouveau Bond is that French-Canadian director Denis Villeneuve will direct. He, too, has pedigree, not least his epic three-part Dune series, the first two films of which have already grossed more than $1 billion worldwide, with Part Three due out in December. “If there’s one thing we can be sure of with Denis, it’s that he will do something interesting with this,” a source within the film industry told me. “He is one of those directors who can turn even a bad script into a good film.”.

    Speaking of which, the other major name already signed up to the reimagining is Peaky Blinders creator Steven Knight. He will write the story.

    Knight seems a natural fit for a darker, more character-driven Bond. His breakout was the screenplay for Dirty Pretty Things, which earned him an Oscar nomination. He went on to write David Cronenberg’s brutal Eastern Promises and the one-man thriller Locke.

    Sources indicate that but it was Peaky Blinders that made his name: a stylized, violent, brooding saga of a damaged man at the rotten heart of a criminal empire, which became a global hit for the BBC and Netflix. Knight, in other words, has previous when it comes to writing moody, morally murky men.

    No need to say much—we know what we’re dealing with here. A man who makes good choices. A star.

    In a recent development, at forty, Pattinson is a little older than Craig was when he got the job in 2005, aged thirty-seven. But the career behind him is hardly that of a conventional leading man. After the teen-idol years of Twilight, he spent a decade deliberately steering away from the obvious: Cronenberg’s Cosmopolis, the Safdie brothers’ Good Time, Robert Eggers’s The Lighthouse, and Claire Denis’s High Life, before returning to the blockbuster fold with Christopher Nolan’s Tenet, and The Batman.

    He’s made stellar choices throughout his career, turning a heartthrob start into a credible run of good, risk-taking roles.

    In a recent development, the first, most critical drop will, of course, be the villain. Because, as they say in Hollywood, a movie is only ever as good as its villain. Without a dastardly supervillain for Bond to shoot his PPK at, Bond is just a red flag in a black suit. No names have yet reared their heads. But that didn’t stop us from suggesting a few candidates.

    It has been revealed that speaking of which, Amazon has shown no indication of a proposal to depart from the Bond-girl tradition. Though it’s (thankfully) likely to be handled sensitively for 2026: expect a complex and fully realized love interest who will still be in a gorgeous dress by the second act.

    Margaret Qualley has emerged as the bookies’ favorite, having already taken part in a Bond-tribute dance at the 2025 Oscars. Sydney Sweeney has said she’s up for joining the franchise, though she told Variety she’d have more fun playing Bond himself.

    Anya Taylor-Joy, Florence Pugh, and Zendaya have also been linked, with the obvious advantage of having worked with Villeneuve on Dune.

    According to recent reports, they were most recently played, respectively, by Ralph Fiennes, Ben Whishaw, and Naomie Harris. It’s not known whether any of them will return to the roles, though history suggests it’s likely.

    It has been revealed that craig’s run offers a rough template, for what it’s worth (which is not much). He was unveiled in October 2005, started shooting Casino Royale the following January, and had it in cinemas by November 2006. Pattinson’s unveiling comes just a few weeks later in the calendar, so a similar timetable would see cameras rolling early next year and a potential release date around the end of 2027. Though that feels like a tight turnaround for such a gargantuan project. Amazon will want to get this right, so given how long it strung out Pattinson’s casting, 2028 seems a more likely ballpark.

    According to recent reports, here’s a boring-but-pertinent fact: three of Daniel Craig’s five James Bond films debuted in October: Quantum of Solace, Skyfall, and Spectre. The remaining two, Casino Royale and No Time to Die, were released in November and September, respectively.

    But this is, of course, guesswork—Amazon has offered no indication that it will follow the Craig timeline, or anything else about the movie’s schedule.

    In a recent development, this is perhaps the most interesting part of the whole process. It began in February 2025, when the Broccoli dynasty (led by long-serving Bond masterminds Barbara Broccoli and Michael G. Wilson) unveiled they were handing over creative control to Amazon MGM Studios (which was formed when Amazon bought Bond’s parent studio in 2022).

    Within hours of the announcement, Amazon’s owner, Jeff Bezos—the world’s richest man—took to X to ask the world: “Who’d you pick as the next Bond?”.

    This followed rumors of a rift between the two parties, with the Wall Street Journal reporting that Barbara suggested to friends that she didn't like the idea of Amazon execs taking a data-driven approach to the series, as well as the use of the word “content” in creative meetings.

    Just as Disney+ has produced many Star Wars spin-offs, Amazon MGM is expected to do the same with Bond—a process that began last year with the first TV series, 007: Road to a Million, a game show hosted by Succession’s Brian Cox.

    Mike Hopkins, head of Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, said in February 2025: “We are honored to continue this treasured heritage, and look forward to ushering in the next phase of the legendary 007 for audiences around the world.”.

    It has been revealed that during her three-day tour of India, the Princess of Wales attended the 2026 Earthshot Prize Ceremony in Mumbai. Prince William founded the initiative in 2020, and it awards environmental solutions with grants to scale and advance their projects.

    For the event, Kate wore an oxblood, floor-length Anarkali dress by designer Mahima Mahajan and paired it with extra-fluffy, voluminous bohemian curls pinned in a half-updo.

    An elegant, extra-glossy wavy hairstyle has long been a beauty signature for the princess, often teamed with a side part, hats, or a polished ponytail. But for the green carpet in India, the royal opted for a much more dramatic style that matches the glamorous mood of her outfit, with tighter, cascading bohemian curls woven into a beautiful half-updo twist for a romantic finish.

    "I would create these curls using a medium-sized tong," recommends Philipp Haug, co-founder of Haug London Haus salon. "Take relatively small sections and use the tongs with a twisting technique, curling one section away from the face and alternating with one section towards the face throughout. Slightly root stretch when you come to the top of the head instead of curling too close to the scalp.".

    To enhance the fluffiness and volume of the curls, shake them out with your fingers instead of combing them.

    Your next special occasion hair inspiration, sorted.

    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Say “Margaritaville,” and most of us will likely imagine a place with strong island vibes: beach chairs in the sand and colorful tropical drinks in hand. That ease and joy remain at the core of Margaritaville brand ethos, but a upcoming collaboration with North Carolina’s venerable Hooker Furnishings reveals a more refined and nuanced side to Jimmy Buffett’s creative vision and style. Mixing warm palettes, natural materials, and layered textures, the furniture collection is at once down-to-earth and luxurious—gorgeous to the eye, yet made to be enjoyed and lived in.

    Recent findings suggest that another thing this collection makes clear about Buffett is that his love of the natural world went far beyond the beach. He had a home for nearly 50 years in Snowmass, Colorado, and the natural beauty of that part of the world was as much of a muse as his legendary island life.

    In a recent development, both come alive in four lifestyle concepts the designers envisioned as they created the collection: there’s Paradise Valley, in which warm leathers, sustainable wood, and earth-tone textures draw inspiration from the Rocky Mountain vistas of the Centennial State; St. Somewhere, with playful Caribbean beach-town elements and subtle nods to surf culture; Island Reserve, which pairs performance materials with elegantly-crafted teak-wood or wicker chairs and sofas to make outdoor entertaining feel as elevated as indoor; and the JWB Signature line, which, among other things, showcases some of the most elegantly designed recliners around, inspired by the “timeless cool” of the man himself.

    So while you won’t find an actual hammock or porch swing in this collection, you will discover well-crafted oak beds, plush sectionals, and outdoor furniture that evoke the same dreamy vision and ease Buffett’s songs and stories are known for. Here are five pieces to help you start creating your own slice of paradise.

    It has been revealed that the intention behind this collection was to create furniture that encourages people to gather and enjoy time together. The Sandbar sectional does the trick, with power recline in the left chairs, lumbar support throughout, hidden Bluetooth speakers to create a surround-sound experience, pop-out cupholders in the center console for easy drink access (and to help avoid unwanted spills), and hidden storage for cozy blankets and throws. And when you need to make room for overnight guests, planned or otherwise, a pull-out full sleeper lives inside the armless loveseat.

    Industry observers note that the handcrafted glass base and organic sea foam stone top have this accent table almost doing double-duty as a piece of sculpture. The modernist line and soft color palette would look just as at home in a house by the shore as it would as an accent piece in an eclectic, maximalist living room in the suburbs. At just 14 inches in diameter and 22 inches high, it’s also petite enough to make a statement in smaller spaces.

    According to recent reports, your bedroom should feel like a sanctuary, and this white-oak poster bed will certainly make it feel that way. The striking cross-beam canopy defines the space between the outside world and the intimate space within; so together with the airy, sunbleached wood and neutral palette, it’ll have you drifting off to sleep each night feeling like you’re at a five-star tropical resort.

    According to recent reports, you can’t exactly embody the Margaritaville lifestyle without someplace to mix up Buffett’s signature cocktail, along with other favorites. This bar cabinet has the sleek look of a midcentury console, but with a twist: the powder blue on the doors is a painted finish, layered over woven linen to give the exterior subtle texture and visual depth. The interior is made of white oak and has multiple shelving areas, hanging stemware storage, an adjustable stone shelf, and removable wine-storage partitions for plenty of glassware, bottles, cocktail shakers, and more. The coral-design handles are, of course, a nod to the brand’s island heritage.

    According to recent reports, at first glance, this looks like a beautifully simple wood pub table, but once guests sit down for dinner or a cocktail, they’ll notice its more playful details. Made with warm maple veneers and contrasting walnut accents, the whimsical counter-height table is designed to look like a surfboard. It’s intended to draw you in and encourage you to relax and savor the moment, whether you’re settling in with your morning coffee or together with friends to toast to a beach sunset.

    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Though her recent red-carpet looks may beg to differ, Brittany Snow is no longer chasing perfection—at least when it comes to her appearance. Instead, the actress, who turned 40 this year and is starring in one of the moment’s most deliciously bingeable series, now in its second season, is focused on aging well and nourishing her skin with intention. “There’s something really freeing about realizing you don’t need to look perfect to feel confident,” Snow notes. “I spent so much of my younger years unfortunately being aware of how I looked. Now, I’m much more interested in just looking like myself, just hopefully a little more hydrated.” That’s where RéVive comes in.

    Snow credits her makeup artist Charlie Riddle with introducing her to the luxe skin care brand and helping her evolve her relationship to beauty. “He has always focused on making my skin look like skin—healthy, hydrated, and luminous,” she says. “He understands that the better you take care of your skin, the less you need to cover it up.”.

    Recent findings suggest that throughout the current press tour, Riddle has been prepping Snow’s skin with RéVive; the brand has promptly become a staple in her personal routine, too. “I was initially drawn to how beautiful my skin felt when Charlie used the products on me,” she indicates. “There was this sense of hydration without feeling like I had a million things sitting on my face. Charlie has taught me that the edit matters; I used to be someone who thought more products meant better results, and now I realize that consistency and quality are much more important.”.

    In a recent development, in addition to the products’ elegant feel and innovative, science-based formulas, Snow also appreciates RéVive’s brand story. “RéVive was founded by a plastic surgeon whose research began with helping burn victims heal,” she says. “There’s something really meaningful to me about a beauty brand that was born out of wanting to help people.”.

    Whether she’s preparing to film a scene, gearing up for a marathon press day, or decompressing before bed at home, she relies on RéVive’s Renewal Moisturizing Night Cream and Renewal Rescue Elixir Oil to hydrate, care for, and rejuvenate her skin.

    Both products are powered by exclusive peptides enhanced by RéVive RVGF Technology—a breakthrough delivery system that targets skin concerns with greater precision to maximize efficacy. The complementary formulas work to renew skin overnight to reveal a healthier-looking, more radiant, and glowing complexion by morning.

    Industry observers note that “My skin goes through so much between filming, travel, and wearing makeup for hours,” she says. “By the end of the day, I really want something that feels rich and helps my skin look refreshed. After using them, my skin feels like glass.”.

    Glowing from the inside out, her recent appearances—be they in character on our TV screens or in late-night talk show clips on our phones—are proof both of RéVive’s results and the confidence that comes from feeling good in one’s own skin.

    Tech Report: I'm a Mom of Two, and This Ernesta Rug Gives Me That Luxe Look With the Easy Cleanup of a Washable Option

    📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 7 min read (1367 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Housebeautiful

    ⏱️ ~7 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • Every item on this page was hand-picked by a House Beautiful editor.
    • Sources indicate that I have to admit, I have a bit of a gripe with washable rugs.
    • While washable rug options have definitely improved over the years, there’s still something about the weight, texture, and character of a traditional rug that I find hard to forgo for the sake of washability.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Every item on this page was hand-picked by a House Beautiful editor. We may earn commission on some of the items you choose to buy.

    Sources indicate that I have to admit, I have a bit of a gripe with washable rugs. For years, the design industry has been trying to convince us that the answer to a beautiful, livable home is a washable rug. And while I understand the appeal, especially as a mom to two young kids, a dog, and a household that sees its fair share of spills, muddy shoes, and general chaos, I’ve just never been entirely sold on the idea.

    While washable rug options have definitely improved over the years, there’s still something about the weight, texture, and character of a traditional rug that I find hard to forgo for the sake of washability. I want a rug that feels substantial underfoot, looks better with age, and doesn’t require me to wrestle an eight-by-ten-foot piece of fabric into my washing machine every time someone spills a juice box.

    Sources indicate that when I learned about Ernesta’s protective rug treatment, I was intrigued. The custom rug brand offers an optional treatment designed to help repel spills and make everyday messes easier to clean, without requiring you to compromise on your rug’s style, material, or size. In theory, it offers the best of both worlds: the look and feel of a beautifully made rug, with a little extra insurance against the realities of family life. Plus, it’s a treatment that’s typically hard to access on your own without going custom through a designer.

    According to recent reports, I actually have several Ernesta rugs in my home (I’m a huge fan of their quality and approachable customization options!), but after swapping in an Ernesta rug treated with the brand’s protective finish in our living room, I don’t think I’ll ever go back to ordering a rug without it. Here’s what you should know about the treatment, how it's held up in my own home, and why I think it may be a smarter investment than yet another washable rug.

    Best for: This rug is an excellent option for families, pet owners, or anyone who just prefers not to have to be too precious with their things.

    Not ideal for: Anyone looking for a quick-ship rug option.

    Bottom Line: The customization of Ernesta’s rug assortment makes it easy to get the exact look and function that serves your home best, including different sizes, non-slip bases, and protections.

    It has been revealed that one of the reasons I love Ernesta so much is how approachable they make the ordering process. There’s no visiting a showroom or making 400 phone calls to try to get the right custom-cut size. You simply log on to their site, browse the options, then choose up to five samples to try for just $10.

    My samples came incredibly swiftly—within a few days, they were at my doorstep, ready for review. Because I already liked the look of the rug we had in our living room (more on that later), I knew I didn’t want to stray too far from the neutral, functional foundation it gave us.

    When we started, we had Ernesta’s Emerson sisal rug in the space. The nubby texture and color looked beautiful, but it was a bit small (it was originally sized to an old home that we have since moved from), and the deeper grooves of the weave made it hard to clean up spills. I have two young kids and a dog, and truly not a day goes by where someone hasn’t spilled yogurt or cracker crumbs or juice on the rug.

    Recent findings suggest that still, I don’t think you should have to sacrifice beauty for function in a family home, and Ernesta helped us find that balance. After debating between a few different styles, I ended up settling on the Cally wool flatweave rug in Camel. Wool flatweave rugs are notoriously durable on their own, and I knew the protective coating would only help it hold up better. Bonus: The tighter weave meant fewer nooks and crannies for gunk to get into.

    Once we decided on our newly introduced style, we measured out the size we’d need, which ended up being around 13 x 15 feet. I loved how easy it was to order the exact size we needed for our space, especially given that it wasn’t a standard measurement. If you’re unsure about the right size for your rug (or how many legs of your furniture should be on the rug at one time), Ernesta has helpful guidance on their site.

    Placing the order was easy; you can opt into the protective treatment before adding the order to your cart, as well as choose other details, like the type of edge binding and whether you’d like to include a rug pad (we chose the attached version).

    Protective treatments for rugs are nothing latest; they’ve been available to design industry insiders for years. That stated, very few DTC companies offer the treatment, unless you’re buying through a designer or want to seek out a supplier on your own.

    That’s what’s so great about Ernesta’s offerings—it’s literally as easy as checking a box before you add your rug to cart. The treatment starts at $62 and increases depending on the size of your rug. Their formula is non-toxic and works by acting as a protective layer between the surface of the rug and any spills or debris, preventing stains from setting in and keeping the fibers intact for longer.

    According to recent reports, receiving and installing our Ernesta rug couldn’t have been easier, especially considering its large size. It was delivered and placed in our entryway, where it waited for a few days until my husband and I had a spare moment to lay it out.

    The rug was packaged beautifully, with thick plastic wrapping protecting the roll, a firm cardboard tube at the center, and fabric wrapping the edges so the binding didn’t get roughed up in transit. I thought this was a particularly nice touch.

    As with most rugs, the corners were a bit flared when we first unrolled it, so here’s my favorite tip: add several ice cubes to any corner you want to lay flat and let them melt. The slow dissipation of moisture will relax the rug's fibers, and by the time it has melted away completely, you should have a totally flat rug.

    I was immediately impressed by the look and feel of this rug—the wool was so soft and plush, and the rubber mat integrated on the bottom meant it did not budge once we laid it down (though it did make it difficult to reposition when we laid it a little wonky initially, word to the wise). There was no “chemical” smell from the protective treatments, and the fibers still felt just as soft as they did on the sample I received before ordering.

    Sources indicate that aesthetically, I love the vibe that this rug brings to the space. It’s soft and plush and cozy, and finally in better proportion with the rest of the room—which is great, because I have a pair of armchairs I won at auction waiting in the wings for their moment. Before, they were floating off the rug and looked odd, but now, they’ll be perfect.

    It has been revealed that logically, the protective treatment was 100 percent the right choice for our family. Not even five minutes after laying it out, my three-year-old squished an applesauce pouch on the rug, and it came up with ease. In the month since having it, we’ve definitely put this rug through the paces of family life, and it still looks as good as the day we opened it. Cleaning it is easy, and Ernesta has a whole page on their site dedicated to care instructions, depending on the material your rug is made of.

    Overall, this is the ideal solution to me: a rug that looks as good as it performs, and doesn’t require any design sacrifice (or yelling from mom) in the process.

    In this day and age, it’s almost a rite of passage for a celebrity to have plastic surgery rumors about them swirling online, but Jennifer Lawrence has been speaking her truth on the matter as of late.

    Last week on Watch What Happens Live, the Hunger Games actress casually slipped into her conversation with host Andy Cohen that she has new breast implants and even credited her plastic surgeon, Steven Teitelbaum, for the “full C” cups.

    According to recent reports, she continues to set the record straight on her cosmetic procedures—this time shutting down rumors that she had a blepharoplasty. Online rumors quickly speculated that Lawrence had undergone upper eyelid surgery, but her latest Instagram post shuts them down. Her makeup artist, Shayna Gold, shared a mailer of products from the actress’s newly introduced haircare line, Mes, and Lawrence reposted the photo to her own story with a cheeky caption. “Iykyk she’s the one who did my bleph,” Lawrence wrote, crediting Gold and pointing to makeup as the reason she looks so wide awake, officially poking holes in any eyelid surgery rumors.

    In a recent development, lawrence has previously been open about her plastic surgery. In October, after gracing the cover of The Cut, she revealed she had work done following the birth of her second child, which the publication then specified as a boob job. One year earlier, the actress told The Latest Yorker, “Everything bounced back, pretty much, after the first one. Second one, nothing bounced back.”.

    Recent findings suggest that while fans aren’t exactly sold on Lawrence’s denial of a bleph, makeup artists often do have tricks up their sleeves for faking an eyelid lift. For starters, placement matters. When emphasizing the crease, apply shadow above the natural crease. “I like patting shadows onto the lid first, then blending the edges after. Too much back-and-forth blending can make the shape disappear,” celebrity makeup artist Christian Briceno previously told Bazaar. Also, opt for an elongated look, like a soft wing, to make the eye look instantly bigger. This also applies to mascara—artists recommend focusing application on the outer corners versus the center.

We promise: There’s something for everyone at your dinner table on this curated list of cocktails.

    Recent findings suggest that does Grandpa only abide by the saying, “If it’s brown, drink it down?” We’ve got a few whiskey drinks that will keep him on ice. Did your aunt who drinks only French reds run through the bottle she brought already? There’s a sangria recipe that’ll have her too busy sipping to snip. Need a warm cup of something strong while you “take the dog for a walk”? There’s an Irish coffee that’ll keep your wits about you. So hurry up and add these cocktail recipes to your Turkey Day menu.

    Here’s a whiskey sour that makes your fall-flavor dreams come true.

    Sources indicate that add ingredients to a shaker and shake without ice. Pour into a glass and garnish with grated nutmeg and a dried apple slice.

    This twist on the old-fashioned adds an autumnal flavor that will keep this classic feeling fresh.

    Combine all ingredients into a mixing glass with ice. Stir until chilled and diluted. Strain into a rocks glass with a large cube. Garnish with an orange peel studded with cloves.

    The delicious spice that goes into a pie doesn’t have to be just for lattes or baked goods.

    In a recent development, cover the rim of a stemless wineglass in simple syrup. Dip in cinnamon sugar and add ice to the glass. Pour in pumpkin-spice liqueur and Josh Cellars sauvignon blanc. Stir, then top off the glass with seltzer.

    This three-ingredient cocktail is easy to whip up but will taste like it was complicated and time-consuming.

    Mix cider and cinnamon whiskey in a Champagne flute. Top with Champagne, then stir lightly until incorporated. Garnish with an apple slice.

    A sweet, fizzy sipper to enjoy before dinner.

    According to recent reports, add all liquid ingredients to a stemless wineglass. Add ice. Stir to incorporate, then garnish.

    It has been revealed that shake ingredients hard with ice until frothy, about 15 seconds. Double-strain into a chilled coupe or martini glass. Garnish with coffee beans, nutmeg, and cinnamon.

    Recent findings suggest that in a mug, dissolve the sugar cubes in a little hot water. Add rum and butter. Fill the mug with hot water. Sprinkle nutmeg on top.

    According to recent reports, squeeze lime juice into a copper mug (or a Collins glass) and drop in the spent hull. Add ice cubes, then pour in the vodka and fill with cold ginger beer. Serve with a stirring rod.

    This rum cocktail will bring back fond memories of warmer weather.

    Sources indicate that fill a tall glass with ice cubes. Add rum. Pour in ginger beer and lime juice. Stir with a barspoon, then garnish with a lime wedge.

    Holidays are synonymous with Champagne, so pop open a bottle of bubbly and pour out one of these delicious cocktails.

    Stir rum, lime juice, and honey thoroughly with cracked ice in a chilled cocktail shaker. Pour unstrained into a Collins glass. Top with Champagne.

    Breaking: We Combed Through All of Amazon’s Holiday Decor and Found 30 Non-Tacky Picks

    💡 Key Takeaways

    • Whether you’re drawn to vintage-inspired charm, opulence and glamour, or a traditional Christmas look, these gems make decorating easier—and many are timeless enough to bring out year after year.
    • Every holiday season, MacKenzie-Childs manages to outdo itself.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Industry observers note that it’s beginning to look a lot like Christmas, and if you’re settling on a holiday decorating vision, you’re likely looking for pieces that feel festive without dipping into tacky territory. So our editors sorted through Amazon’s vast selection of holiday decor to find 30 non-tacky finds you’ll be proud to display.

    Whether you’re drawn to vintage-inspired charm, opulence and glamour, or a traditional Christmas look, these gems make decorating easier—and many are timeless enough to bring out year after year. Shop classic tree trimmings, wreaths and garlands, elegant mantel accents, and elevated pieces for your holiday tablescape. Whether you’re looking for a tabletop tree or plaid pillow covers for a Ralph Lauren-inspired holiday look, you’ll find it ahead starting at $12.

    Every holiday season, MacKenzie-Childs manages to outdo itself. Whether you choose between a quirky snow globe inspired by the brand’s signature tea kettles or this versatile tabletop tree, it’s sure to make a statement in your space.

    In a recent development, nothing claims Ralph Lauren-inspired Christmas quite like tartan. These plaid pillow covers are available in a handful of coordinating color combinations, so at just $21 for a two-pack, we suggest snagging a few options to mix and match.

    It has been revealed that even those who are picky about bedding can see the charm in swapping your linens for the holiday season. This red-and-white set is actually reversible, giving you the choice between a toile awash in a festive holiday print and classic stripes.

    According to recent reports, this pre-lit garland brimming with berries and pinecones is a low-stress garland option. Wind it around a dramatic staircase, place it on top of your mantel, or even drape it across your dining table.

    Although Amazon has plenty of solid ornament sets, we’d rather go for colorful baubles that give off a collected-over-the-years vibe—even if you just picked them up in this 25-pack.

    It has been revealed that whether you want to add a secondary tree to a bedroom or live in a small space and lack room for a full-size tree, check out this adorable tabletop option. It’s equipped with over 50 lights, has flocked branches, and is easy to add tiny baubles to.

    Dress up your kitchen or bathroom with these festive cotton towels, featuring a traditional English toile print and classic plaid. They’re a charming complement to your favorite holiday hand soap.

    According to recent reports, your Christmas decorating isn’t complete until you add a wreath to your front door. This year, snag a pre-lit option adorned with pinecones, flocked branches, and berries. Reviewers are impressed by how lifelike it looks.

    Sources indicate that for a vintage-inspired Christmas, these golden-hued jingle bells bring a warm, antique feel to your decor. Hang them on the tree or a front door wreath to welcome guests, or use them as a festive accent on your table.

    Leave it to Ridhi, the designer-loved brand, to drop the tree skirt of our dreams. With green and white stripes, contrasting red piping, and functional bows, this is the perfect blend of trendy and timeless.

    You don’t need to spend a fortune to add a dose of holiday cheer to your space. Case in point: For less than $20, you can scoop up a 30-pack of these flocked bottle brush trees to scatter around your bookshelves and tables.

    Christmas calls for having sweet treats at the ready. Lenox makes this possible with this adorable candy jar that’s shaped like an ornament.

    In a recent development, building a collection of unique and meaningful ornaments takes time, which means you probably need to buy some solid baubles to fill space. Add texture with a set of velvet ornaments—this dusty blue will pop nicely against your tree’s green branches.

    According to recent reports, glasshouse’s holiday candles are an editor favorite for setting a festive mood. Their seasonal scents linger in the air for hours, and they make a thoughtful and stylish gift for any holiday host.

    It doesn’t get more traditional than a cable-knit stocking—especially when they’re “hung by the chimney with care.” We like how this set comes with red, green, and cream varieties.

    Sources indicate that if you’re looking for timeless Christmas decor that you’ll be able to use year after year, look no further than Balsam Hill. This classic beaded garland will never go out of style.

    According to recent reports, give your table a touch of candy-cane-striped flair with these taper candles. We’d suggest styling them with candles of varying heights and colors for a glowing, layered effect.

    Sources indicate that something about these ceramic trees feels so nostalgic. This 18-inch version is the perfect size for tabletop styling and lends a pop of color to any space.

    Sick of the traditional tree toppers? This year, finish off your spruce with a metal bow. Not only will it look lovely with a variety of home decor styles—from farmhouse to maximalist—but just imagine the way it’ll reflect the twinkle off of your Christmas lights!

    Dreaming of a coastal Christmas? Look no further than this rattan tree collar, which will even make a holiday spent in a landlocked place feel like you’re lounging by the ocean. Plus, it’s available in three natural shades to best suit your existing decor pieces.
